thread:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty SIREN fired — service: inference-gateway — high 5xx rate detected in us-west1. 5xx rate = 6.8% (60s). Incident INC12345 paging maria (oncall) -> devin. https://pagerduty/INC12345
maria (oncall): acked. I'm on it, checking dashboards and logs now.
devin: standing by, will assist with rollouts if needed.
maria (oncall): quick triage: graphs show spike concentrated on /api/v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. Upstream auth-proxy returning 502/504. Tail of auth-proxy logs shows repeated "upstream timeout" and "broken pipe".
ops-runner: confirming - nginx upstream timeout 110s, many connections in CLOSE_WAIT. Grafana: auth-proxy error rate correlate with keepalive count surge. Pushing link: https://grafana/d/abc/auth-proxy
maria (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) scale auth-proxy pool 4->8 replicas 2) restart pods one-by-one 3) enable circuit-breaker on embeddings route for heavy clients 4) notify customers. Doing step 1 now.
devin: running kubectl scale deploy/auth-proxy -n prod --replicas=8 (will watch health).
ops-runner: scaling started. Also increasing liveness probe threshold to avoid thrashing during restart.
carla: Customer Ops — prepping a short notice for affected customers (embeddings-heavy). Draft ready, will post to status once we confirm drop in 5xx.
sre_lead: FYI if this is file-descriptor exhaustion we should consider short-term tcp-keepalive tuning + follow-up bug. Good to get reproducible traces.
maria (oncall): rolling restart now: kubectl rollout restart deployment/auth-proxy -n prod; restarting pods one at a time.
pagerbot: Deploy job auth-proxy-roll-1710697805 started by devin. Watch for pod readiness events.
maria (oncall): after first two pods restarted 60s window 5xx -> 4.0%. After third pod -> 2.1%. Continuing restart.
ops-runner: cache warmed on restarted pods, observed fewer timeouts for /api/v1/generate. Latency for most clients back to baseline.
carla: status update sent to customers flagged earlier. No major SLA breaches so far; a handful of requests retried by clients.
maria (oncall): error rate trending down to ~0.9% over last 120s. Looks stabilized. Leaving notes for follow-up: suspect keepalive FD leak under high connection churn; need repro harness + heap/FD metrics.
maria (oncall): handing off active monitoring to devin for the next hour. Creating follow-up ticket INF-2742 with logs and suggested mitigations. @devin you own oncall.
devin: ack and taking over. Will keep 30m watch and open bug with reproducer logs.
pagerbot: Incident INC12345 acknowledged by maria (oncall). Handoff complete — next oncall: devin.
carla: adding incident summary to status page and scheduling postmortem sync with SRE + Platform tomorrow.
sre_lead: thanks team. Good mitigation and clear handoff notes.
|end of thread|"
